selection: Lowest 2023 log loss; exact ties choose smaller C
featureRule: Keep all baseline inputs. For each team's last eight eligible games, subtract the opponent's pregame last-eight points-against average from points scored, and subtract the opponent's pregame last-eight points-for average from points conceded. Average residuals across games with an opponent history; include the usable-game count. Zero residual and zero count if no opponent history exists.
timingRule: Target and nested opponent history both use kickoff minus 24 hours, assumed score availability kickoff plus 48 hours, and exclude same-week results. Nested history uses only games before the historical matchup, not later games available at the target cutoff.
history: Regular season only; up to eight games carry across season boundaries; 2014 is warm-up
role: Offline research candidate only. No automatic primary replacement or live issuance. A separate prospective protocol must be registered before future shadow forecasts.
limitations: Corrected historical snapshot with assumed publication timing
Opponent averages are a one-pass adjustment, not causal or recursively schedule-adjusted ratings
Exposed 2024-2025 outcomes provide exploratory evidence only
